summary: Frontend-only verification of two changes on TallyDekho: (1) Daily Trend animated bar chart on /cashflow-report, and (2) shared time-filter persistence via AsyncStorage key 'cashflow_period' between Home (/(tabs)/index.tsx) and Cashflow Report (/cashflow-report.tsx). All primary flows pass. Round-trip persistence works both ways (Home->Report and Report->Home). Bars render and animate per period. Regression checks pass — Home shows Sales/Purchases/Expenses tiles, Cashflow card, and report hero/Income-vs-Expense/Key Metrics still render.

issues: Active period chip uses very subtle 'rgba(26,26,26,0.09)' tint over ivory background; contrast between active/inactive chip is low. Consider stronger active-state background or border for better tap-affordance on mobile.

react_native_issues.issue: Expo tooling warns package versions are behind expected: expo@54.0.35 (expected ~54.0.37), expo-constants@18.0.13 (expected ~18.0.14), expo-file-system@19.0.23 (expected ~19.0.24). Non-blocking but should be aligned.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Increase visual contrast for the active period chip in /app/frontend/app/cashflow-report.tsx (periodChipActive style) — current 18% brand tint is subtle.
OPTIONAL: Bump expo / expo-constants / expo-file-system to expected versions per Expo CLI warning.
critical_code_review_comments: CashflowCard expand button had no testID; I added testID='cashflow-expand-btn' to /app/frontend/src/components/CashflowCard.tsx to enable robust E2E testing. All interactive elements should have testIDs.
cashflow-report.tsx correctly rebuilds AnimatedBar via key={period} on TrendChart, guaranteeing animation replays on period change.

Home uses useFocusEffect to re-read AsyncStorage when navigating back — correct pattern. Home has 4 filters (7D/1M/3M/6M) while report has 3; report ignores 6M on load (falls back to default 7D) — behaviour matches spec note.
handleFilterChange on Home persists filter to AsyncStorage; setPeriod/changePeriod on report also persists. Round-trip works.
seed_data_creation: None — all data mock-first via /app/frontend/src/services/api.ts and local PERIOD_DATA.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test bypass: set localStorage.auth_token='mock_token_123', then reload; tap 'Skip' on onboarding. To reset default 7D filter, remove localStorage 'cashflow_period'. testIDs added: cashflow-expand-btn (expand icon on Cashflow card), filter-7D/1M/3M/6M (Home filter tabs). Report screen period chips do NOT have testIDs — they are matched by text content ('7D','1M','3M'); consider adding testIDs 'report-period-7D/1M/3M' for future tests.
rca_of_issue: N/A — both features implemented correctly and pass all specified acceptance criteria.

verification_evidence.1_default_home_filter: 7D tab has active bg rgb(255,255,255); other filters transparent. localStorage cashflow_period initially null.
verification_evidence.3_report_default_7D: Report opens with 7D chip highlighted (bg rgba(26,26,26,0.09)) and 7 day labels Mon..Sun rendered with green income + red expense bars (animated via Animated.timing).
verification_evidence.4_report_3M_tap: Tapping 3M chip updates localStorage.cashflow_period='3M', chart re-renders with 3 month labels (Jan/Feb/Mar), Net Cash updates to ₹2,46,000.
verification_evidence.5_home_back_reflects_3M: After go_back(), Home filter row shows 3M active (bg white), Sales KPI shows ₹12.45L (3M value), Receivables +14.6% — confirms KPI/metrics/cashflow reflect the shared filter.
verification_evidence.6_home_1M_persists: Tapping filter-1M on Home writes '1M' to localStorage. Reopening report shows 1M chip active with 4 week labels W1..W4 and Net Cash ₹84,200 (1M mock).
